sn4.14:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati ekasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
sn4.14:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti.
sn4.14:2.2: ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti.
sn4.14:2.3: yannūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyāti.
sn4.14:2.4: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
